info.title: Senior Software Engineer
info.description:
Hi, I'm Mat 👋 I'm a software engineer from Phoenix, AZ who started in Salesforce and never stopped picking up new things.

I spent the first decade of my career going deep on the Salesforce platform — 6x certified, building custom UIs, integrations, and automation. Lately I've had the chance to work across a broader stack, and what keeps me curious right now is how AI is changing the role of the engineer — less implementer, more director. The craft is shifting toward knowing what to build, how to break it down, and how to guide something toward the right answer rather than just writing every line yourself.

Contributed to a library of custom Claude Code skills and practiced spec-driven development — commit generation, PR creation, code review, and S3 transfer automation.
